test_title: PYST 19: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in two rows facing each other. Each row has four persons. Q and R are sitting in front of each other. R is the immediate neighbour of S and T. W is sitting to the immediate left of T. W and U are diagonally opposite. V and Q are not next to each other. Who is in front of T?
solution:
Given: Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in two rows facing each other.

Each row has four persons.

1) W is sitting to the immediate left of T.

2) W and U are diagonally opposite. 

3) R is the immediate neighbor of S and T. 

4) Q and R are sitting in front of each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df9985998ccbcf004349bd526ec84785ff3108900faccddbb7ac49d261af6fa6.png] 

5) V and Q are not next to each other (This implies that V will sit at the end of the row).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c81427662eb491614d582d2ea9679d05c2a2eb2cc850f68f7e91af82b55b877.png] 

Here, 'P' is in front of T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
